summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of role-based tab bar fix. Doctor login (drtest@vaidhyaji.example.com) shows tab labels 'Dashboard, Appointments, Patients, Earnings, Profile' and each tab renders the correct doctor screen (DoctorHome with Namaste + stats, appointments-list with 'Clinic Queue' + 'Appointments' title, patients-list with 'My Patients' + search input, earnings screen with 'Total earnings' hero). Freshly-registered patient (pat_bug_88053@vaidhyaji.example.com) shows the ORIGINAL patient tab labels 'Home, Feed, Consult, Reminders, Profile' with correct screens (patient dashboard tiles, AYUSH Wisdom feed, 'Find your Vaidya' doctor discovery, 'Medicine reminders'). No cross-contamination between roles.
critical_code_review_comments: Doctor onboarding step 3 language chips (do-lang-*) do not toggle via headless mouse click on web preview — RN Pressable/TouchableOpacity render on web isn't receiving the synthetic click reliably. Not blocking the reported bug fix (worked around by calling /api/doctor/onboard directly), but worth verifying manually in Expo Go / native. testID is set on outer wrapper; the actual onPress handler may be on an inner Pressable child.

Frontend text 'Vaidya workspace', 'Clinic Queue', 'Patient Records', 'Total earnings' are rendered via CSS text-transform: uppercase — case-sensitive tests should compare uppercased text. Screenshots confirm labels render correctly.
seed_data_creation: Registered patient pat_bug_88053@vaidhyaji.example.com / Patient@123 / phone 9876588053. Doctor drtest@vaidhyaji.example.com onboarding was completed via direct backend PUT /api/doctor/onboard (Ayurveda / BAMS / reg AYUSH/BAMS/2020/00099 / 5 yrs / ₹500) because Playwright headless clicks weren't triggering the RN language chips.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix from iteration 22 verified end-to-end. Custom tab bar in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx correctly switches between PATIENT_TABS and DOCTOR_TABS based on useAuth().user.role, and the tab-screen files (feed.tsx, consult.tsx, reminders.tsx) early-return the doctor-specific screens when role === 'doctor'. Screenshots at /tmp/*.png. Note: onboarding language chip clicks are flaky in Playwright web-preview — for future onboarding tests either seed doctor via backend PUT /api/doctor/onboard, or use manual native testing.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: doctor role saw only home tab replaced with DoctorHome but other tabs still rendered patient content because the tab bar was a fixed PATIENT_TABS map and (feed|consult|reminders).tsx had no role check. Fix (already applied by main agent) reads user.role in CustomTabBar to pick DOCTOR_TABS, and each tab-screen file returns the corresponding doctor screen when role === 'doctor'. Verified working.
